reviews.author: shefali srivastava
reviews.text:
If you're traveling on the Hyderabad-Bangalore highway and looking for a great place to stop for a meal, Hotel Pranav is an excellent choice. Whether you're in the mood for breakfast, lunch, or dinner, this place offers delicious food and a comfortable dining experience.

Food & Drinks

One of the highlights here is their filter coffee—rich, aromatic, and perfectly brewed, making it a must-try for coffee lovers. Their menu caters to different mealtimes, ensuring you get a satisfying meal regardless of when you stop.

Hygiene & Convenience

Cleanliness is a top priority at Hotel Pranav. The washrooms and handwash stations are well-maintained and stocked at all times, which is especially important for female travelers. There's also a dedicated bathroom area that helps mothers with diaper changes and cleaning up their little ones, making it a family-friendly stop.

Ambiance & Location

The location adds to the charm, with a water body right across the highway, offering a scenic view and making the stop even more refreshing. The pleasant weather in this area enhances the experience, making it a great place to relax before continuing your journey.

reviews.author: Anuja P
reviews.text:
En route on a journey the driver suggested this place and we stopped there for lunch.

The food is simple Andhra fare and has the home cooked feeling to it.

I enjoyed having good Andhra food while enjoying the view of the lake right opposite to the restaurant. It was a great mental break considering the view and good food. The pappu here is a must try!

UPDATE:

DECEMBER 24
there was a strong stench of toilet permeating the restaurant. The food was good but I was hurrying through the meal because of the strong stench. It was unbearable. I am taking away two stars now even though the food was good.

Cleanliness comes first.

reviews.author: Nithin Mohan
reviews.text:
The best veg hotel in that region, you don't have to look for another option if you're driving through here.

There's dedicated parking available for two wheelers and four wheelers. It's more than sufficient for even a large crowd.

There are also clean and hygienic toilet facilities are available for the customers.

Once we entered the hotel, it was very clean and organized. The food items are super delicious. Decent behaviour from the staff members.

Also one fruit and juice shop is available in the same compound.

reviews.author: I W Shaik
reviews.text:
This restaurant is very economical and hygienic, I always stop over while traveling from Bangalore to Hyderabad. One of the best restaurant to have breakfast. You just need to take a right turn from the signal and get there as it is located on the other side of the road. There is a good parking space and fruit stall present near parking. Good place for travellers as they can use the toilet facilities which is decent enough.

The service is slow as they do not have enough staff, however the food is decent enough and the place is worth a visit.

reviews.author: Shaik Shavali
reviews.text: Overall good spot for quick bite or a full meal. Breakfast, lunch, snacks and dinner is served here (Vegetarian - South Indian, North Indian and Chinese cuisine is available). There Is ample parking place. Well maintained and clean place. Toilet is a key thing especially on highways, people generally stop at hotels to mainly use toilet but here that seems to be a problem especially for the ladies toilet there is an attendant lady who demands money and if people don't give she keeps murmuring which is bad and my family was worried did not use it. They told me after leaving that place. Management should do something about this so that people are comfortable using the facilities provided by the hotel. Other than this the taste service and cost seems to be good.

reviews.author: Abhilash Janardhanan
reviews.text:
Good place for breakfast & juice.

Breakfast main items were good but the sides (chutney etc) we're not that great.

Offers a great parking space with the easiness in road accessibility. Apart from the restaurant, there is a juice shop (offers fruit juices and other snacks - which is excellent ), fruit shop, sweet corn stall etc.

Toilet is not neatly maintained. That's the only main concern I found (personal view).

Overall, a good place for breakfast (Andhra style) with family & an excellent place for juice time.

Cheers!
